verdict.rationale: Gitea's own documentation states that Git Large File Storage is available when enabled and the server's Git version is at least 2.1.2, so the product natively supports storing large binaries via LFS. That single conditional mention is the only evidence, with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: LFS configuration and storage backend documentation, file locking or quota details, independent or hands-on corroboration of LFS use.
